source.role: executable donor for photo-composite characters and image/text-to-3D objects

semantics: selector = first SUCCESS child; sequence = all children SUCCESS; a HELD leaf is not SUCCESS

policy.reason: Donor skill searches the web for named people's photographs. This reconstruction keeps that node in the tree and does not execute it. Operator-supplied image paths are the only photo inputs the runner accepts.

children.title: Named or photo character for a 2D Phaser game

children.summary: If assets/characters manifest already has the slug, copy sprites and stop.
SOURCE node: WebSearch four expression photos of a named person. HELD unless the operator already supplied files.
fill_expression_slots over operator-supplied raw/{normal,happy,angry,surprised}.*
For each new raw file: MIME from magic bytes; @imgly/background-removal-node model=medium output=foreground PNG.
SSD MobileNet v1 minConfidence 0.3, pad 0.25. Else alpha>10 bbox, head_ratio 0.45, then trim pad 0.05.
800x300 PNG, frames 200x300, order normal|happy|angry|surprised, sharp fit=contain.
Phaser Container: arms, Graphics body from unit U, head sprite on top. Never a floating head.
EXPRESSION 0..3, hold 600ms, EventBus PLAYER_DAMAGED→ANGRY, SCORE_CHANGED→HAPPY.
POST /v1/image-to-3d should_texture=true. Local file → base64 data URI. Poll 5s, max 360.
POST /v1/rigging height_meters default 1.7. Download rigged GLB plus walking and running.
resize textures to 1024, gltf-transform dedup/prune/weld, meshopt, webp. Skip if CLI missing.
log bbox, rotationY often Math.PI, feet on -min.y, SkeletonUtils.clone, fadeToAction, mixer.update.
Image route if a photo exists, else text preview→refine. One object per prompt.
Props, vehicles, buildings are not rigged.
Same GLB optimize. Integrate with scene.clone(true), not SkeletonUtils.
Ask for a reference image before text. POST Marble image mode.
full, 500k, 100k SPZ + collider GLB + panorama + meta.
SparkRenderer before SplatMesh; three@^0.180; antialias false; Y-flip and upward raycast.
retrodiffusion-generate.mjs. img2img strength 0.5-0.8. Paid. pixelArt:true in Phaser.
Loreweaver generate_image(prompt, kind) is not photo-conditioned and does not emit a mesh.
3D: assets/3d-characters manifest, then Sketchfab/Poly Haven/Poly.pizza, then BoxGeometry. 2D: hand-coded matrices.
